chunks: But they disobeyed the command of their Lord; so they were destroyed by a thunderbolt, and they could only gape,
ai.seo_question: What happened to those who disobeyed their Lord's command according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Banu al-Mughirah or the people of Hud, illustrating how sudden divine retribution catches the arrogant off guard despite their vigilance. The 'thunderbolt' (sa'iqah) signifies a direct, physical manifestation of God's power that validates the truth of the prophets, serving as a warning to those who reject divine authority while observing the signs around them.
